# UEEF Framework Domains

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-framework-indexes.mjs. Do not edit manually. -->

This folder is the physical organization layer for fast UEEF navigation. It groups stable numbered packs and nested pack families by domain.

## Domains

- [Foundation and Runtime](foundation-runtime.md) - Start here for activation, installation, runtime sequence, workspace readiness, and safe local execution.
- [Engineering Quality](engineering-quality.md) - Use for architecture, code quality, security, performance, scalability, assurance, and engineering-health control.
- [Application Engineering](application-engineering.md) - Use for implementation owners across frontend, backend, database, API, stack packs, identity, grids, and application shells.
- [Product UI and Frontend Experience](product-ui-frontend-experience.md) - Use for product UI, UX, accessibility, design systems, themes, responsive behavior, skeletons, design intelligence, and production frontend craft.
- [Delivery, Gates, and Evidence](delivery-gates-evidence.md) - Use for testing, documentation, DevOps, enterprise readiness, quality gates, scorecards, checklists, templates, examples, scripts, references, roadmap, changelog, and future planning.
- [AI, Agents, and Spec Workflow](ai-agents-spec-workflow.md) - Use for AI behavior, memory, review, decision routing, browser session policy, model orchestration, skill invocation, and spec-driven work.
- [Repository Intelligence and Modernization](repository-intelligence-modernization.md) - Use for repository graphing, project mapping, modernization plans, dependency/refactor strategy, and large-project reuse.

## Use order

1. Start with this domain folder.
2. Open the selected domain page.
3. Load only the listed owner packs needed for the task.
4. Use [`../MASTER_INDEX.md`](../MASTER_INDEX.md) only when exact file inventory is needed.
